nom: Personal Day Doing The Work Salicylic Acid Acne Treatment

avis.texte: Works wonderfully, my skin has never felt more healthy and clean. I don't have anymore breakouts. I use this with the gel as well!
This toner is an absolute dream, and genuinely helps me clear away the harshness of the day! What a beaut!
This has made so much of a difference with my skin and hasn't irritated it at all, and usually products always cause some kind of reaction since my skin is so sensitive. I love it!!
it "cools down" my acne a lot and makes it not look as aggressive which makes me feel a lot better about it!!
I recently started getting acne on my chin and tried so many different products. Things that did work at all would majorly dry out my skin. This product helps but goes dry my skin at all.
I was having a stubborn breakout and this helped fix it. I use it daily along with the priming milk and moisturizer and it's working great!
I have acne prone skin and i don't get as much anymore when I moved to Personal Day for all my skincare stuff. A little bit tingly at first but overall it helps out a lot.

avis.titre: Why did everyone keep this a secret??
avis.texte: This has been a game changer. I struggle with hormonal acne and I've tried a lot of things. My skin has been looking so much better and feeling cleaner since I started using this.

I've probably used about half of the bottle, and I use it every day. It seems to do what it promises to do - a good first step in skin care and also help keep acne away! I currently think I'll be a customer of this product for a long time. SO MANY products irritate my skin and cause breakouts... but this is doing it's job! And because of which, I've bought some other items from PD, as well. I'd say give this a try if you're on the fence; it might be a great product for you!
So far I'm loving the products, it's helped calm my skin down.
I use it 2-3 times a week only but have found it to be so nice on my skin and it really helps with breakouts

My 12-year-old daughter is the one who actually uses this the most. We can really see a difference overnight, but even more so when she uses it consistently (at least two to three times a week). Her skin just glows! I am grateful for the Personal Day line. I trust it on her young skin.

This is the stinkiest smelliest toner I've ever used. Have you ever taken a shot? Well this smells like pure raw nasty rail vodka. I can't even tell you if it works, I can't continue to use it. I will return immediately bc I am GAGGIng at how this smells on my face
It has really helped clear up my acne and also helps to prevent any news spots from forming.
I cannot explain how well this toner has worked for my skin. Literally it is my holy grail and I don't know how I lived without it for so long
I have been using this product for about three weeks now and i absolutely love it. i use it every night and when i wake up my skin is absolutely glowing. a new must to my routine.

avis.titre: I don't want to be dramatic but I cannot live without this.
avis.texte: I've been using this for the past year, and it is truly THE BEST. I've always loved Salicylic Acid for my skin, but I had never used Azelaic Acid before and I swear that's the game changer in this. When I have spots, it def helps my acne. If I feel one coming on, it def helps. And it doesn't burn at all, so you know it's not ruining your skin. Also, ever since I've been using this, I get waaaaay less breakouts. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't upset it at all. It only helps. For context: I am a 32 year old female.

avis.titre: Only Celeb Skincare that's WORTH IT
avis.texte: As someone with very acne prone skin, I loveeee this product. Healing while giving a glow like I have Botox. Usually treatments are too harsh for me and this isn't. Love love love.

avis.titre: Ugh i love this so much
avis.texte: I've only been using this product for a week now but man do I love the way it feels on my skin! There is no irritation or redness, it's very gentle on my skin. I've also noticed that a lot of my acne marks/hyperpigmentation is starting to fade little by little. I use almost everything Personal Day in my skincare routine and let me just say, this stuff works!!

I'm really loving this toner. I have been using it for about a week, maybe a bit longer. When I got it, I had a cluster of pimples on the side of my chin (this is where I breakout the most). The cluster had been there for a few weeks and would not go away. Since I've started using the toner, the spots have faded significantly. You can still see them but they look way better than they did and I'm not as self conscious about them. I will definitely continue to use this product! I have been using it 2x a day and it has not been drying out my skin at all which I really like.

I have been using this product since it came out and it's worth purchasing! I have noticed a significant difference, and I promise I am not BSing. If you're struggling with acne do yourself a favor and include this in your routine. 🤩
I've been using this for months and is one of my favorite products!

avis.titre: This item saves my skin from acne flare-ups!
avis.texte: I've been using this acne treatment toner for over a year, and I barely get active pimples now. I've dealt with acne since I was 17 and now I am 26 and I seriously cannot live without this product - not joking. I use it 2-3 times a week. Thank you Personal Day for making this product!!
Love that this toner is gentle to use every single day without drying out my skin, and still keeps me clear of breakouts. Constantly reordering this so I never run out!!!

This product does seem to be helping my acne. I haven't had a really bad breakout in awhile so I do attribute that success to the product. Nothing really seems to ever make my acne go away but less horrible breakouts is a win
Was looking for something to replace my expensive Curology order and this had all the same ingredients. Works just the same!

I've been using this for a month and am so happy with the results! I use it every other day, and have seen fewer acne flare ups. Its gentle formula doesn't make my skin itch or peel, and the acne marks and hyperpigmentation seem to benefit from this as well! This is my go-to salicylic acid forever and I'm telling everyone about it!
Love this product! Works better than any cleanser or face wash I've used in the past.

I love this product, I don't think it's too harsh for my skin, however I think with how my skin has been for the past year and a half just need a stronger medication of some sort. That being said, I do like how gentle and effective this product is at stopping oncoming acne, so I will be repurchasing!
I had the worst face and body acne flareup. This immediately calmed down the redness and has been steadily reducing the breakouts the more I use it consistently. I will never be without this!
For someone whose skin dries easily with these kinds of products, I was happily surprised with how well this product works without overly drying!

i've tried many acne treatments over the years that have either dried my skin out, bleached my skin, or given me a chemical burn but this product WORKS!! my acne is under control and is going away with this. I have worked my way up to be able to use it nightly and i love it. I've used it for two months religiously and my skin has never been better.

This is amazing! Follow the instructions and you'll never see your pores again. I haven't had any breakouts since using this product or ingrown hairs for that matter. It's easy to use and gentle on my sensitive skin. 10/10 would recommend to everyone!

Really does what it says! Got a free little trial while dealing with my first round of acne ever in my life (24 btw) I had the biggest pimple that was underneath my skin for almost 3 weeks (having had another pimple next to it for a whole month react the same way); tried hot compression, patches, peels, serums but nothing until this pretty little thing cane and flattened that sucker out, it is now about 2 weeks later and its slowly healing but I honestly thank this product for helping

avis.titre: Does seem to help! A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Noticed visible improvement on emerging acne, though a little irritation when I used too much product. Seems to work best when used carefully and sparingly.
This product has cleared my skin so many times. I will forever use these products from the healthy ingredients to the business is just really great. You always know what is going in the products.
This product works so well with my acne without drying out or being harsh on my skin.
Love how light this is. So hard to find a SA treatment that doesn't dry my skin out
For 5 stars I would have to have clear skin. My skin is more clear, I just wish I felt like it helped prevent breakouts.

avis.titre: So gentle, but actually WORKS to dry up existing pimples!
avis.texte: This DOESN'T dry out the skin I apply it to, but it DOES dry up the erupted acne. LOVE this whole line of products!!
I love that this product works really well and is also a great price for the amount you get. Thank you!
I've been wary of trying new products because my skin is so reactive, but this has done nothing except clear and calm it. I've been using for about 3 weeks now!
This really helped calm my skin when I had a flare up of cystic hormonal acne. It's not gonna work right away, you need time with azaelic acid but it helped with inflammation
Used on my upper back and neck to clear post work out acne. I am very happy with the salicylic acid's performance.
Best one I've tried so far. Sticking with this one going forward!
so amazing! whenever i feel i'm breaking out a lot i use this for a couple days and it clears up so fast!!

avis.titre: Best Salicylic Acid I have used
avis.texte: I love this Salicylic Acid treatment because it is the first one I have used that doesn't make me dry and itchy. Perfect for my sensitive skin. I have used it as a spot treatment at night as well and it started healing a zit by morning.
This salicylic I think is one of the most gentle formulas I have ever used and it's quite effective!

I have eczema so my skin can be really dry but I also get acne as well on occasion which as a female in her 30's can be a little annoying and embarrassing. I came across Lili's brand when I watched her Go To Bed With Me Harper's Bazar video and I ordered this toner. I LOVE this stuff. It actually works, I always put it on at night and the nights that I do, some of the acne has been gone the next morning. A little goes a long way and it doesn't dry or irritate my skin which is a BIG bonus because sadly most products like this do. I highly recommend this product, 100/10!! She really knocked it out of the park with her skincare brand. You can tell she cares by the products she has come out with!

I've struggled with adult cystic acne and rosacea for years now and my mom said to me the other day that my skin was the best it's looked in years. I've tried prescription creams, prescription acne pills and nothing has worked the way this serum has. Absolute game changer for me. Before and after pictures included!
I have hormonal acne and this has helped even out my complexion. I pair it with the powder cleanser. Love it!
I've used this for about a month now and it works great! I like to use it as a spot treatment on really big deep under the skin zits and you can see them shrink over night.
Love this product! Has done wonders for my skin! I suffered from perioral acne and this cleared it right up.
I am really liking this toner! I struggle to find SA toners that are gentle enough for my reactive skin and this one has checked all the boxes and feels so hydrating as well!

I don't have enough words to describe how much I LOVE this product. I was using Paula's Choice salicylic acid treatment prior to this one and let me tell you…this is better! Not only do you get more product at a great price, but it doesn't have a greasy residue that Paula's Choice leaves behind. It has worked wonders on my bumps & acne leaving me with smooth, clear skin. I truly can't live without this product and if it's not already in your skincare routine, it needs to be!

This product is SO GOOD. I really enjoy how gentle yet incredibly effective this treatment is! I love how it dries down quickly, making it easy to layer other products with. I love how it helps keep my pores clear while getting rid of existing whiteheads. I'm a huge sucker for azelaic acid and am so happy it is formulated in this product. I would 1000% repurchase and recommend.
This is the first acne treatment I've used that's actually saved my skin. It doesn't burn like other acne products, and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean. I love love love Personal Day!
Don't usually add reviews but wishing I took "before" pictures because I have finally had clear skin after adding in personal day.

Azelaic acid is the main reason I've completely fallen in love with this product. After doing extensive research, I discovered that azelaic acid is incredibly effective in preventing the growth of acne-causing bacteria, which has been a game-changer for my skin. It works beautifully to reduce redness, calm inflammation, and smooth out my complexion. Knowing that this ingredient targets the root cause of breakouts gives me so much confidence in its effectiveness. The visible difference I've seen is nothing short of amazing!

I've struggled with acne all throughout my 20s! Since starting Personal Day I have not had a single active breakout!! I don't know what's in this stuff, (well actually i do because they are open about all the ingredients!!) but it's amazing!!
I've consistently used this on my cystic acne and it has gotten so much better since. It cleared up quickly and my skin is a lot less oily now.

avis.titre: tried once and already into it
avis.texte: THIS IS WHAT IVE BEEN LOOKING FOR my skin feels so smooth after one use like WOW. I was a little worried give my prior issues with irritation and dryness but this did just the trick without drying me out. Can't wait to incorporate this into my routine. slay
Never write reviews but I love how easy this acid treatment is to apply, how refreshing it feels, and how it has brought clarity to my skin. Thanks, Personal Day!
okay this brand is literally AMAZING. i've been using the acid treatment for a few weeks and my skin feels so much smoother already. like my acne scars r fading!!! will def keep using!

i'm so stressed all the time and my skin was looking AWFUL but this brand saved my life fr. the acid acne treatment is my fave, makes my skin feel fresh and clean without burning or making it dry. my friends even noticed my skin clearing up!! feels so good to actually see a difference for once lol. luv luv luv it 💕
I was skeptical and thought this was too much product to be that powerful at first. Then it made my bumps go away over night…so I guess it's just a lot of a good thing.

I genuinely cannot describe how much I love this product. My skin has been going through such a rough patch lately so I was nervous about how my skin would respond to this product. However, now that I've been using it consistently for a couple of weeks now, I can tell you that one of the best choices I've ever made for my skin is using this product! It feels so gentle on my skin and contains the best ingredients for my acne. It doesn't dry out my skin but helps with my skin's texture and redness. I absolutely love it and I definitely recommend it!!

avis.titre: Toner is out, treatment is in
avis.texte: This product paired with the cleanser is what gets my skin to feel brand new. I used to be a toner girl because it felt like it got the rest of my makeup or dirt off my face. So, I replaced that with this - and now it does all that PLUS gives my skin that little boost it needs to keep acne at bay.
